text.name: lb_animalCounts
text.text: Husbandries checked: %s | Animal groups: %s | Known animals: %s

text.name: lb_animalUnknown
text.text: Groups with unknown count: %s | Unvalued groups: %s

text.name: lb_animalDetail
text.text: Native quote per animal: %s | Group reference value: %s

text.name: lb_animalQuoteBasis
text.text: Native quote times count; no additional fee or transport adjustment is applied.

text.name: lb_animalBasis
text.text: Animal values are shown separately and are not added to covered assets.

text.name: lb_animalOverlap
text.text: Loaded livestock trailer quotes include animal value; modded quotes can vary.

text.name: lb_animalMissing
text.text: Transported animals, ridden horses and unsupported animal systems are omitted.

text.name: lb_animalMetadata
text.text: Age and reproduction remain unavailable until their native units are verified.

text.name: lb_animalsUnavailable
text.text: Livestock coverage is unavailable or incomplete. Zero must not be assumed.

text.name: lb_noAnimals
text.text: No animals found in the supported owned husbandries checked.

text.name: lb_buildingSaleBlocked
text.text: This placeable currently blocks selling; value is not sale proceeds.

text.name: lb_noBuildings
text.text: No owned buildings or placeables found.

text.name: lb_buildingsUnavailable
text.text: Building coverage is unavailable or incomplete. Zero must not be assumed.

text.name: lb_inventoryIssues
text.text: Unavailable records: %s | Excluded containers or compartments: %s

text.name: lb_inventoryObjectCount
text.text: Physical or stored objects in this entry: %s

text.name: lb_fermentingUnknown
text.text: Fermenting; progress unavailable. Current contents are shown.

text.name: lb_inventoryUnavailable
text.text: Stored-goods coverage is unavailable. Zero must not be assumed.

text.name: lb_inventoryNoItems
text.text: No nonempty goods recorded in the containers checked; coverage is partial.

text.name: lb_inventoryBasis
text.text: Quantities only; no separate inventory value is added to the asset subtotal.

text.name: lb_inventoryProvenance
text.text: Container ownership does not prove cargo ownership, including contract crops.

text.name: lb_inventoryMissing
text.text: Bunker/ground heaps, construction stock and unsupported mod storage are omitted.

text.name: lb_unknownLand
text.text: Unvalued parcels: %s | Parcels with unknown area: %s

text.name: lb_unknownEquipment
text.text: Unvalued owned equipment: %s | Other excluded equipment: %s

text.name: lb_partialWarning
text.text: Partial coverage: this is not net worth or a credit assessment.

text.name: lb_quoteContents
text.text: Quote may include contents or animals; inventory is not added separately.

text.name: lb_quoteContentsIncluded
text.text: As-is quote; any bundled contents are included.

text.name: lb_noEquipment
text.text: No equipment associated with this farm found.

text.name: lb_landUnavailable
text.text: Farmland coverage is unavailable or incomplete. Zero must not be assumed.

text.name: lb_equipmentUnavailable
text.text: Equipment coverage is unavailable or incomplete. Zero must not be assumed.

text.name: lb_noIssues
text.text: No collection issues detected within this build's limited coverage.

text.name: lb_basisCash
text.text: Cash and native debt are the current active farm balances.

text.name: lb_basisLand
text.text: Land uses current game-configured parcel prices and total parcel area.

text.name: lb_basisVehicle
text.text: Equipment uses the game's current sale quote, including specialization changes.

text.name: lb_basisBuilding
text.text: Buildings use engine monetary values, not temporary construction undo refunds.

text.name: lb_basisBuildingSale
text.text: Building value does not guarantee a sale is permitted or that proceeds match.

text.name: lb_basisQuote
text.text: Sale location, condition changes and other mods may change the final proceeds.

text.name: lb_basisExclusions
text.text: Leased, borrowed and unidentified ownership are excluded from owned assets.

text.name: lb_basisMissing
text.text: Not separately valued: inventories, standing crops and timber.

text.name: lb_basisDebt
text.text: External financing and other liabilities are not included in native debt.

text.name: lb_basisSubtotal
text.text: Known covered assets sum available cash, land, owned equipment and buildings.

text.name: lb_basisUnknown
text.text: Unavailable values are omitted from subtotals; a verified zero is shown as zero.

text.name: lb_basisRefresh
text.text: This is a dated snapshot. Refresh to read changes made since it was captured.

text.name: lb_basisNoGrade
text.text: Creditworthiness uses observed cash history with explicit evidence gates; no loans are issued.

text.name: lb_error
text.text: The report could not be refreshed. Close and reopen it, then check log.txt.

text.name: lb_policyMeaning
text.text: Policy changes score thresholds only. Evidence requirements stay the same.

text.name: lb_scoreScope
text.text: Internal simulation score; not a credit-bureau score, default probability or loan approval.

text.name: lb_insufficient
text.text: Insufficient history or unresolved evidence; no score assigned.

text.name: lb_evidenceCount
text.text: Completed, reconciled periods in the latest cycle: %s / 12

text.name: lb_creditScope
text.text: External liabilities are unverified. No principal repayment schedule is available.

text.name: lb_noDscr
text.text: Actual accounting profit and debt-service coverage are unavailable.

text.name: lb_cashPrincipal
text.text: Observed cash after interest, before principal: %s

text.name: lb_collateral
text.text: Known asset quotes, separate from repayment score: %s

text.name: lb_collateralWarning
text.text: Partial quotes exclude unverified liens and external debt; assets do not add score points.

text.name: lb_nativeFinanceWarning
text.text: Native history dates, order, padding and retained window are unverified in FS25.

text.name: lb_nativeFinanceMeaning
text.text: Raw game records; sign/category semantics are unverified. Treatments below are bank policy.

text.name: lb_noNativeFinance
text.text: No readable retained records. Past activity is not reconstructed.

text.name: lb_historyBasis
text.text: Local cycles start at installation; period 1-12 follows the game's seasonal order.

text.name: lb_historyNotYear
text.text: Cycle numbers are tracking labels, not calendar years. Native archive slots are not imported.

text.name: lb_historyLimit
text.text: History retains up to %s completed or closed periods per farm.

text.name: lb_historySave
text.text: History saving is attempted during the game save; reload checks matching evidence.

text.name: lb_historyMissing
text.text: No observed history yet. New and existing saves start with a partial period.

text.name: lb_historyUnclassified
text.text: Unclassified movements and reconciliation gaps prevent scoring; zero is never substituted.

text.name: lb_forecastMissing
text.text: Insufficient history: a full comparable, reconciled seasonal cycle is required.

text.name: lb_forecastMethod
text.text: Scenario repeats the latest observed matching seasonal period; confidence is limited to one cycle.

text.name: lb_forecastScope
text.text: Next 12 full periods only. Current partial period, capital spending and financing are excluded.

text.name: lb_forecastNoBalance
text.text: Cash before principal is not a safe loan payment or a forecast closing bank balance.

text.name: lb_forecastNet
text.text: Scenario cash after interest, before principal: %s

text.name: lb_nativeNotTotals
text.text: These records are not dated cash-flow totals and never establish complete observation.

text.name: lb_persistenceCandidate
text.text: Save integration present; verify in Windows
